references.text: The same context where Jotham asks whether they have acted in truth and integrity with Jerubbaal
The fulfillment of Jotham's curse - God repaid Abimelech and the men of Shechem for their wickedness
Israel's lack of faithfulness to Jerubbaal and his house after all the good he had done
The expression 'rejoice' is used regarding mutual joy between ruler and people, similar wording
Contrast between rejoicing and sorrow, mutual joy between God and His servants
A call to walk in truth and integrity with the Lord, using the same Hebrew term for integrity
